name: Consumer Compliance & Conduct
description: Complaints, fair lending, UDAAP, and conduct risk indicators.

metrics.name: time_to_resolve
metrics.description: Median days to resolve a complaint

metrics.name: adverse_impact_ratio
metrics.description: Approval rate of a group divided by that of the reference group

conventions.rule: Disparity measures follow knowledge/credit_risk and spec 0074: measured at the applied cutoff, with the reference group named.
Protected-attribute data is segregated and used only for fairness testing, never as a dimension in general analytics.

insight_rules.reason: Fairness ratios are reviewed through fair-lending review, not decomposed ad hoc.

caveats.text: Fair-lending results require review by fair_lending_review before any use.

chart_conventions.rule: Show complaint rates per 10,000 accounts, not raw counts, when comparing products of different size.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
